question_patterns: 為什麼我沒吃飯，肚子就會叫
first_sentence: 這是肚子叫！因為肚子空空，胃就會動。
facts: 胃和腸子會自己收縮，推著食物走
胃空的時候，裡面的空氣和液體會晃動
吃飽以後，肚子通常就不太叫了
ask_back: 肚子叫的時候，胃是空的還是滿的？

bridges.likes_dinosaurs: 恐龍肚子餓的時候，會不會也咕嚕叫呢？
bridges.has_cat: 貓咪肚子餓的時候，也會叫嗎？

author: claude-haiku

question_patterns: why does my stomach make noise
why is my tummy so noisy
en.first_sentence: This is a tummy growl! Your empty tummy squeezes and gurgles.
facts: Your stomach and gut squeeze on their own to move food.
When your tummy is empty, air and juice slosh around.
After you eat, your tummy usually stops growling.
en.ask_back: Do you think a tummy growls more before lunch, or after lunch?

bridges.likes_dinosaurs: Do you think a dinosaur's tummy growled when it was hungry?
bridges.has_cat: Does your cat meow when its tummy is hungry?
